_about: Public-domain John Johnson (1662-1725), Vicar of Cranbrook, the Usager theologian of the eucharistic sacrifice who stayed within the established church but wrote with the nonjurors, for the Word Hoard: his Theological Works, The Unbloody Sacrifice and the Clergyman's Vade-Mecum among them (Library of Anglo-Catholic Theology, 1847, two volumes), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 40 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

jjohnson-works-1: The theological works of the Rev. John Johnson, vol. 1 (Oxford : John Henry Parker, 1847)
jjohnson-works-2: The theological works of the Rev. John Johnson, vol. 2 (Oxford : John Henry Parker, 1847)

_alternates.jjohnson-copies: Other scans of the 1847 Works; Brett's Life of the Late Reverend John Johnson (1748)
